title: The TRT Fallacy
summary: NH argues that TRT has become YouTube fitness's new fake-natty lie: real TRT is a narrow medical therapy at low physiological doses, while most influencers 'on TRT' are cruising after heavy cycles or skipping lifestyle fixes. He dismantles the logic of maintaining enhanced size on TRT doses, insists TRT is neither natty nor healthy at those doses, and urges young men to fix their environment and stay natural.
claims: He is anti-PED to the max: PED use is unnecessary in most cases and cannot be justified logically, though he still watches pro bodybuilding
TRT is the new lie of YouTube fitness; he dislikes it more than open heavy steroid use because it continues fake-natty deception once nobody believes the natty claims
Proper TRT is only for males in whom natural boosting has been shown impossible and outside testosterone is needed to be healthy; this disqualifies about 99% of YouTube TRT users
In practice 'I'm on TRT' means one of three things: ex-steroid users who wrecked their hormones, low-T people who will not fix their lifestyle, or liars covering heavy cycles
Legitimate TRT aims at health (preventing heart disease, depression, fat retention); muscle is a byproduct and no doctor prescribes it to get jacked
Real TRT replicates low-to-mid natural production; a real doctor never prescribes double natural output, and anything above physiological levels is PED use even if prescribed
Injected testosterone keeps levels stable while natural levels fluctuate, so even at an equal 150 mg the injector stays anabolic constantly and gains more
Gaining muscle slowly is not a pathology and not a justification for TRT; doctors refuse borderline low-T because better ways to raise it exist
Handing out TRT casually mirrors the painkiller epidemic: it makes people dependent on a substance they could have done without

Young men who spent their teens gaming, eating junk, avoiding sun and exercise burn out their hormones; under 25 you have not seen your body's anabolic potential, so fix your environment before pinning at 22
His own youthful lifestyle was not conducive to gains; the purer the environment he gives his body as he ages, the bigger he gets
Supraphysiological test replaces the need to learn training and programming, so when users plateau their only answer is more drugs
TRT works as a gateway drug: users start at 'TRT' and creep the dose up, sometimes doubling it for a taste of glory while still claiming TRT
Size built on grams of drugs cannot be maintained on 100 mg; it is like keeping 20-inch arms after cutting biceps volume from 100 to 1 for three years
TRT only maintains what heavy drug use built; someone who skips the cycles and goes straight to TRT has nothing to maintain
There is no natural limit; a perceived limit usually means you are not anabolic enough yet and will be if you keep training and taking care of yourself
Naturals cannot compete on the same stage as enhanced athletes, like a man fighting a tiger; but natural progression, spiritual and physical, is infinite
Retired enhanced pros turn to selling coaching and plans and claim TRT so their size seems to come from knowledge
People who quit natural training because they stalled should not give programming advice to naturals; some enhanced coaches are fine on exercise selection and injury prevention
Steroid use snowballs: first cycle, PCT, cycle again, then blast and cruise; what ex-users call TRT is the cruise phase
TRT is not natty: any exogenous hormone, even 50 mg on top of normal production, revokes natty status for life
500 mg is about three times natural production and cannot be healthy; calling it TRT does not stop it damaging kidneys, liver and heart
Even enhanced lifters take years because growth comes from time spent exposed to hormones and tonnage; the same slow accumulation is why naturals have no hard limit
PEDs inject months and years of training into the bloodstream, so naturals can never match enhanced physiques
Rich Piana was loved despite massive drug use because he was open about it instead of using it to sell lies
Youth clinics hand out testosterone and growth hormone to anyone who pays; that is legalized drug use, not TRT
Legitimate TRT is mostly men in their 70s-80s or rare young men whose hormones never kicked in; at 25, 35 or even 50 you should still be anabolic
Natural anabolism makes men look older in an attractive way, while drug abuse prematurely ages them, wrinkled at 45
Those who wrecked healthy hormones with PEDs deserve no pity for needing TRT, like destroying your liver and begging for a new one
Long-term users who come off lose all natural test production and shrink rapidly; no PCT restores it, which is why they cling to TRT to keep selling
Do not take advice from people who never reached inspiring muscularity without PEDs; likewise if he lost 30 lb you should stop listening to him
TRT does not undo years of abuse; an ex-pro of 10 years claiming to be healthy is not
He did idiotic things with his diet in the past whose damage cannot be repaired, a debt he will pay sooner or later
Mass monsters downsizing claim aesthetics, but it is really doctors warning them they will die, and they taper because they are addicted
99% of people on TRT should not be on it; do things the natural way and you will be rewarded
